{{Top}}
The '''Roshu Sune''' were a radical [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] splinter group of the [[Gotal Assembly for Separation/Legends|Gotal Assembly for Separation]] on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], they caused the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|Battle of Antar 4]]. Later, they were involved with the [[Gotal hostage standoff]] on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]].
